newsitem.title: USA: Calif assemblyman submits bill to 'realign' state.
newsitem.headline: Calif assemblyman submits bill to 'realign' state.

text.p: California state Assemblyman Tom McClintock has introduced legislation to streamline state government by eliminating or consolidating departments and agencies, his office said on Monday.
Assembly Bill 19, the so-called Bureaucracy Realignment and Closure Act of 1997, would create an independent commission charged with examining state departments, agencies and services.
Its goal would be to "realign," eliminate or consolidate agencies and departments that are obsolete, wasteful or duplicative, the assemblyman said in a statement.
